experiment_scope: integration smoke only; not scientific evidence
randomness: The dataset seed is 42. Initialization seeds are [42]; training randomness (optimizer, batches, and training sampler) is fixed at 42. Diagnostic simulator seeds are derived from the dataset seed, fixed training seed, iteration, and split.

architecture.diagnostic_evaluation: Full train and validation partitions at every optimizer iteration; validation metrics are observational only.

A_current_qnim_instrumented.note: A and D are the same trainable architecture; no duplicate fit is run.

C_frozen_ansatz_trainable_readout.readout_training: Full train partition; the circuit ansatz is initialized by model seed and held fixed; validation is diagnostic only.

D_trainable_ansatz.readout_training: Existing QNIM warm-start and periodic refit; validation is passed only to the non-mutating diagnostic observer.
